note: Blind benchmark ledger. set=dev: the nine 2026 hacks with readable victim source, labelled by hand before this harness existed and used to build lenses, so in-sample. set=stream: proofs of concept added to DeFiHackLabs after commit 0520ddb (see stream-freeze.txt); intake, predictions and labels written by bench/stream.py in that order.

label.mechanism: solve() takes a `solver` address with no check that it is the caller or consented, and pulls on that address's standing allowance
label.labelled_by: hand, from the proof of concept's root-cause note, 2026-09-25 (bench/labels/hacks-2026.json)

label.mechanism: share pricing reads the vault's raw token balance with no per-share-class accounting of the stETH backing one class
label.labelled_by: hand, from the proof of concept's root-cause note, 2026-09-25 (bench/labels/hacks-2026.json)

label.mechanism: launch() is permissionless and forwards the caller's calldata verbatim into the V4 PositionManager as the factory, unvalidated
label.labelled_by: hand, from the proof of concept's root-cause note, 2026-09-25 (bench/labels/hacks-2026.json)

label.mechanism: approveAndCall calls an arbitrary target as the token itself, guarded only by the first word of calldata equalling the caller
label.labelled_by: hand, from the proof of concept's root-cause note, 2026-09-25 (bench/labels/hacks-2026.json)

label.mechanism: addPoolAndSell and _sellToken both refund BNB to the caller before their remaining state work, with no guard on the path
label.labelled_by: hand, from the proof of concept's root-cause note, 2026-09-25 (bench/labels/hacks-2026.json)

label.mechanism: per-tier bookkeeping is credited for every batch item even when amounts[i] == 0, so a zero-balance sender inflates the record without moving value
label.labelled_by: hand, from the proof of concept's root-cause note, 2026-09-25 (bench/labels/hacks-2026.json)

label.mechanism: the Axelar express path is callable by anyone and the module authorizes against a sourceAddress string the caller supplied, not the caller
label.labelled_by: hand, from the proof of concept's root-cause note, 2026-09-25 (bench/labels/hacks-2026.json)

label.mechanism: initializeAccount is gated only on a transient flag that EIP-1153 keeps set for the whole transaction, with no already-initialized guard
label.labelled_by: hand, from the proof of concept's root-cause note, 2026-09-25 (bench/labels/hacks-2026.json)

label.mechanism: totalAssets() values idle non-asset WETH as asset while redeem() hands that same WETH out, so the books count it twice
label.labelled_by: hand, from the proof of concept's root-cause note, 2026-09-25 (bench/labels/hacks-2026.json)
